inputs.name: createPlanning.root
inputs.description: The repository root string passed to planGit to produce the Git context used to create the planning API. Path and repository validation are delegated to planGit.

inputs.name: handlePlanningRequest.api
inputs.description: The PlanningApi object used as the dispatch table for the request. The handler calls an own property selected by request.operation with request.input, so the selected property must be callable.

inputs.name: handlePlanningRequest.request
inputs.description: The request object whose operation selects an own API property and whose input is passed to that property. A missing request or an operation not owned by the API becomes an invalid-input result.

outputs.name: createPlanning
outputs.description: The resolved value is the PlanningApi returned by planningService for the Git context produced by planGit(root). It exposes the service API rather than the Git context itself.

outputs.name: handlePlanningRequest
outputs.description: The resolved value reports either the selected operation's value or a failure object. Errors from request dispatch or the operation are caught and returned with a code, message, and null path.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An unknown operation creates an Error that the handler catches and converts to a failure result. Rejections from planGit or planningService propagate from createPlanning without being caught here.
